scope: Named primary members from public class documentation. Subset never means full class parity. Remaining exported classes have no member-level certification.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.limits: CommonJS default class only; Worker mode has no DOM, Node, external npm modules, CSS, marketplace or external-settings events. Renderer-only UI hooks (addRibbonIcon/addSettingTab/addStatusBarItem/registerView/registerEditorExtension/registerMarkdownPostProcessor/registerMarkdownCodeBlockProcessor) require the trusted renderer host and reject in Worker mode without host.ui. Ribbon icons render a text glyph fallback. registerEditorSuggest bridges onTrigger/getSuggestions to CodeMirror autocomplete and selectSuggestion through the editor mutation host; rendering uses the display-text hook. Protocol handlers dispatch from the in-app engine:protocol window event (no OS obsidian:// registration). Hover link sources are registration-only; hover-link event transport is not wired. registerBasesView uses a minimal QueryController (type/config/app only), exposes render(container) with optional onload/onunload, rejects reserved ids table/cards/list, cleans up on startup failure, and does not implement query data, grouping, sorting or full BasesConfig semantics. registerExtensions maps single-segment file extensions to an already-registered view type; the main-area plugin-view host mounts the view when that extension is opened, and an ownership stack restores the latest remaining registration on unload. Lifecycle completion is async in Engine.

classes.name: Component
classes.limits: Await load/unload. Child load/unload callbacks are not guaranteed synchronous.

classes.name: Events
classes.limits: Standalone emitter; host-provided event coverage separately bounded.

classes.name: Vault
classes.limits: Text formats only. DataWriteOptions rejected. configDir .crafactory. Only modify event, others rejected. Snapshot stats; no multi-process locks/fsync certification. Vault.rename/trash support non-root TFile and TFolder subtrees; getResourcePath returns the storage asset data URL.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.limits: One active editor and minimal MarkdownView; renderer-only leaf factories support getLeaf(new), getRightLeaf(no split), getLeavesOfType, detachLeavesOfType and revealLeaf; no heading jump, newLeaf reuse/split, openState or layout save. Only file-open event, snapshot timing differs from reference focus/leaf behavior.

classes.name: Editor
classes.limits: One UTF-16 selection; Worker snapshot and async serialized expected-text host mutations. Source mode full-file offsets; live selections inside hidden properties rejected.

classes.name: TAbstractFile
classes.limits: Identity retained at unchanged paths; file/folder rename keeps the moved object subtree identity at its new paths.

classes.name: TFile
classes.limits: Filesystem snapshot ctime/mtime/size, not full reference stat semantics.

classes.name: MetadataCache
classes.limits: app.metadataCache resolver only; its class export and all host cache events rejected. Exact cache positions/shapes and complete link resolution unfinished.

classes.name: Notice
classes.limits: String message to shared toast; duration, multiple notices and DOM are not reference-equivalent. DocumentFragment rejected.

classes.name: MarkdownView
classes.limits: Minimal command context. Other inherited members not individually behavior-audited; no DOM view integration.
